faqs.question: What is Lyovapor L-210 used for?
faqs.answer: Lyovapor L-210 is a freeze dryer used for lyophilization of aqueous and solvent-containing samples across biotechnology, pharmaceutical, chemical, and food research.

faqs.question: How cold does the condenser get?
faqs.answer: The lowest condenser temperature is -55°C, reached rapidly through EcoStream cooling technology.

faqs.question: What is the condenser capacity?
faqs.answer: Condenser and condensing capacity are both rated up to 6 kg, with condensing capacity at up to 6 kg per 24 hours.

faqs.question: What's the environmental impact of Lyovapor L-210?
faqs.answer: It carries a GWP index of 3, achieved through natural coolants used in the EcoStream cooling system.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Basic and Pro configurations?
faqs.answer: Pro configurations add heatable shelves up to 60 ± 1°C and temperature-based endpoint determination, while Basic configurations use unheatable shelves and pressure-based endpoint determination.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro later?
faqs.answer: Yes, Lyovapor L-210 supports upgrading from a Basic to a Pro instrument as application needs change.

faqs.question: Does Lyovapor L-210 support automated, unattended runs?
faqs.answer: Yes, method programming combined with a sample protective state enables fully automated freeze-drying runs.

faqs.question: What does the hot gas defrosting feature do?
faqs.answer: It speeds up melting of ice layers on the condenser coil, reducing downtime between runs on defrosting models.

sections.title: EcoStream Cooling and Modular Design
sections.description: Cooling performance and environmental impact don't have to trade off against each other, and that's the core idea behind EcoStream. Natural coolants keep the GWP index down to 3, while the cooling system itself still reaches a stable -55°C condenser temperature rapidly, letting a drying process begin sooner rather than waiting through a long cooldown. That stability holds even at scale, with complete solvent collection maintained for water-based samples up to 6 L. On the chamber side, the instrument installs on a bench or trolley depending on lab layout, and several drying chamber options, from manifold setups to heatable shelf configurations, accommodate everything from single flasks to bulkier sample loads.

sections.title: Time-Saving Automation
body: Watching a freeze-drying run manually, guessing at when primary drying ends and secondary drying begins, wastes both time and confidence in the result. Infinite-Control removes that guesswork directly.

A live graphical display on the 4.6-inch touch screen keeps process parameters visible throughout the run, while advanced process analytics pin down precise endpoint determination across both primary and secondary drying phases. Method programming combined with a sample protective state means a run can proceed fully automated once it's started, without needing constant supervision. Where hot gas defrosting is included, melting the ice layer that builds up on the condenser coil happens faster too, cutting downtime between cycles.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: Lyovapor L-250 product information: EcoStream technology, sustainability certification, and configuration options.
body: EcoStream's compressor design enables the condenser to reach temperatures as low as -85°C, one of the coldest condenser temperatures in BUCHI's Lyovapor range.
A GWP rating of just 4, using natural coolants, keeps environmental impact low even at this deep-cooling performance level.

Condenser capacity reaches up to 5 kg, with condensing capacity up to 4 kg per 24 hours, and a stable ice condenser temperature supports efficient collection of water and organic-based solvents alike.
A smart compressor design reduces electrical energy consumption, and the system lowers heat output and noise emissions in the lab compared to less efficient designs.
Infinite-Control technology delivers precise process control through the display and software, including sample protective state and endpoint determination for safe, short freeze-drying runs.
The hot gas feature speeds up melting of ice layers on the condenser coil between runs.
Several drying chambers accommodate high sample quantities and a wide range of containers, from single flasks to bulky samples.
BUCHI's sustainable production and product life cycle commitment is officially certified by the ACT label for L-250 Basic and Pro configurations, valid in the EU, UK, and USA.

sections.title: EcoStream and Sustainable Certification
sections.description: Sustainability claims mean more when they're independently certified rather than self-reported, and that's exactly what the ACT label provides for L-250. The certification confirms BUCHI's commitment to sustainable production, product life cycle management, and innovative technology, valid in the EU, UK, and USA, and downloadable for both the L-250 Basic and Pro configurations. That certification sits on top of genuine technical performance: an innovative compressor design that reaches -85°C, a GWP rating of just 4 using natural coolants, and reduced electrical energy consumption from the smart compressor itself. The result is lower heat output and noise emissions in the lab, alongside the deep-cooling performance freeze-drying at this temperature range demands.

sections.title: Precision Control and Sample Protection
body: A freeze-drying run that runs too long, or ends before the sample is actually dry, wastes both time and material. Infinite-Control is built to prevent both outcomes.

Precise process control runs through the display and software together, giving direct oversight of a run as it progresses. Sample protective state and endpoint determination work together to keep runs both safe and short, avoiding unnecessary extended drying time once a sample has actually reached its endpoint. Where ice buildup on the condenser coil would otherwise slow down turnaround between runs, the hot gas feature speeds that melting process up directly.
